title: Inbox Row
description: One captured lead entering the discovery inbox — spec §5 inbox schema: date, ticker, market, source_channel, coverage_class, one_line_mechanism, status. Capture is a ten-second act from a phone on site; capture and analysis are never the same activity. Produced by Discovery [S1A] (Lane 1 bench alerts, Lane 2 channels 1–8, Lane 3 human flow — everything enters the same inbox with its tag); consumed by /triage. Claude never originates tickers from memory: every row exists because a named stream or Vyom supplied it. See spec/investment-os-v3.2-master-spec.md §5.

ticker.description: Ticker as supplied by the stream (e.g. WOR, WTC, ENGN). Never originated from model memory — streams supply names (spec §5; Constitution rule 2).

market.description: Listing market/exchange of the ticker (e.g. ASX, NYSE, NASDAQ).

one_line_mechanism.description: One line: the suspected cause of mispricing (we hunt causes, not cheapness — spec §1, §5). A capture-hygiene bound, not analysis; the full mechanism case belongs to later stages.

status.description: Pipeline position of this lead (spec §4 stages): new = captured, awaiting triage; triaged = verdict exists, routed onward; killed = kill logged with reason (kills are data for channel scoring §5 and calibration §11); locked = evidence pack locked [S3]; underwriting = at Underwrite [S4]; redteam = in adversarial passes [S5]; synthesis = with Vyom for the one-paragraph thesis [S6/S9]; logged = ledger row exists; bench = parked on the Lane 1 bench with pre-computed buy prices; monitoring = Maintenance [S16] falsifier watch.

coverage_class.description: Coverage class declared for the retrieval run (spec §2.1). C0 = user-supplied evidence set; C1 = enumerated universe (full roster/feed, every row processed); C2 = bounded-source harvest — never 'all qualifying companies'; C3 = open-web scout, non-exhaustive sample only, never proof of absence. Dynamic, blocked, paywalled, or truncated sources downgrade the class; more searching never upgrades C2/C3 to C1. All Lane-2 sweeps are C2 unless run against an enumerated feed. Shared enum — identical across all schemas in schemas/; changes only by versioned edit (spec §16).

source_channel.description: Discovery stream that supplied the name (spec §5). Claude never originates tickers from memory — every lead carries this tag. lane1_bench_alert = Lane 1 bench price alert; ch1–ch8 = Lane 2 event-scanner channels (index deletions, insider clusters, capital-cycle signals, multi-year lows ∩ survivability, special situations, filing deltas, activist/substantial holders, tax-loss windows); lane3_human = Lane 3 human flow (forums supply tickers, never theses); vyom_direct = supplied directly by Vyom. Feeds quarterly channel scoring; weights may not change until four quarters of scored data exist. Shared enum — identical across all schemas in schemas/; changes only by versioned edit (spec §16).
